name: ton_s1c
_comment: S1c (new attacks): source = first capture session 23-24 Apr 2019 (flows 0-9,974,944; benign and scanning); embargo 50,000 flows (plus the 8.8 h gap); deployment = rest, 349 windows (dos, injection, ddos, password, xss, ransomware, backdoor, mitm all new). Binary F1 and false-alarm rate are the meaningful targets.

shortcut_policy._comment: Exclude each listed host/OS fingerprint feature whose single-feature AUC on the source train block is >= 0.99; other flagged features stay and are reported; an all-features variant is reported as sensitivity.
